name: Replays
state: In progress: PRs 1 to 4, 5a, 5b-1, the engineering-only boss rule, 5b-2, 5b-3a and 5b-3b merged (hidden replay features, replay extras and REPAIR removed; snapshot codecs in src/gameplay/snapshot; the detached world in src/app/world/detached; the record, recorder and verify, with the round-trip check over the determinism corpus; one seed type, one start record and one run start for live play and detached worlds, ruleset v21; replays refuse engineering-only bosses; reward picks and rerolls are actions and a held screen holds detached and headless worlds; scene frames are in the record and verify plays them; a browser gate that live campaign and Boss Rush runs verify from their seeds), 5c-1 (the production recorder keeps plain-start runs in the tear-replays database on this device) the replay clock (only simulated ticks are counted, and replays test contact as play does, so long live runs store and verify) and 5c-2 (WATCH opens a kept run on the replay screen, re-simulated and drawn by the game's renderer, and the older replay shows the stage of each moment); open: run ends, a run that ends in death verifies (its record ends with the tick the player died in) and a restarted run keeps its record, with a rule test over every way a live run ends
summary: Players reach two replay systems today: Ghost 2 (position samples in localStorage, used by the REPLAYS tab, the feed and leaderboard links) and the Ghost V3 capsules (re-simulated, in IndexedDB, used by VAULT, CAREER and the Theater). The plan replaces both with one versioned record and five plain modules (record, store, watch, share, verify), moves the replay world and snapshot codecs out of TearBench, and deletes src/ghost (118 replay modules and about 800,000 characters today).
next: Merge the run-ends PR. Then a build rule that a test build never writes to the production cloud or leaderboards, the plan-and-guards PR and the One Replays PR. The status timers (burn and the rest) go into the canonical hash with a ruleset step and a gold refresh. VAULT listing kept records and the Recorded before this update label go with PR 8. The plan's hand-over section has the exact steps.
owner_action: Deploy the Firestore chunk-write rules from the merged rules PR.
